purpose: Bounded TRAIN-only falsification of whether conservative certificates have enough real headroom to justify native hardware/scheduling work; not a publication or device-speed claim.

selection.rule: first 8 IDs in the already frozen balanced TRAIN32 order; no content/output filtering
selection.tokenization: Use llama_tokenize on raw prompt bytes, add_special=true, parse_special=true; no new chat-template wrapping. Record tokenizer/model IDs, full token length and retained tokens. Keep first min(128,N) token IDs including source tokenizer BOS; no EOS insertion/removal beyond tokenizer semantics. Short-prefix screening only, not long-context evaluation.
selection.sampling: Greedy argmax with deterministic smallest-token-ID tie; no random sampling. Process retained prefill, then choose and feed 8 greedy tokens, including EOS/EOG if selected (fixed-step diagnostic, no semantic early stop). Record actual steps and tokens.
selection.primary_scoring: Autoregressive decode steps only; prefill diagnostics separately. Separate routed, shared, and dense FFN classes and layer/token/expert counts.

reference: CPU raw-W8 row-scaled FFN with dynamic A8 inputs, I64 integer dot and the existing F32 scale_output contract throughout prefill and decoding. GGUF supplies original non-FFN tensors. This is not original-GGUF numerical equivalence and not a physical AiF run. All target FFNs are canonicalized, including DeepSeek layer0 dense and layers1..26 routed plus the actual merged shared branch of I=2816. Shared amax is over the real merged branch, not split into two metadata experts. OLMoE all layers routed. Preserve non-FFN tensors. Verify every target hook and all prefilling/decode coverage; fallback cannot silently count as canonical.

primary_activation_quantizer.rounding: C++ std::round of F32 quotient; ties away; same finite/underflow rules as reference

shadow_quantizers.scope: post-hoc diagnostics on primary reference activations only; no free-running W8A6/W8A4 quality/speed claim

primary_bounds: integer block-L2, width128, sum of block isqrts and min global bound
gate-dot-conditioned integer interval using G,V,C,X,d and 128-bit checked arithmetic; raw gate dot treated as explicit oracle capability

secondary_deflation.fit_rule: Per model/layer top16 sum of actual q_x[j]^2 from first4 TRAIN jobs, decode8 positions ONLY; each common layer/token input counts ONCE, not duplicated across selected or shared experts. Ties by coordinate ID. Freeze coordinates before scoring last4; no prefill energy.
secondary_deflation.rule: exact contribution on stored coordinates + residual L2 bound; metadata bytes and host work reported

witnesses.name: true_amax_oracle
witnesses.purpose: optimistic upper envelope; free witness and metadata compute are explicitly unavailable runtime assumptions

witnesses.name: fixed_first_up_page
witnesses.purpose: paid causal policy; original contiguous rows only, seed rows never counted as skipped
witnesses.policy: Fixed original row-major Up page at logical offset0, seed rows=floor(16384/H); pilot H2048 => first8 complete rows. Partial/padding rows and any crossing explicitly tracked. Single16KiB witness policy used for both16KiB and hypothetical4KiB opportunity diagnostics. Always pay entire seed page and force all its rows read, even h==0; do not label it a64KiB four-plane wave.
witnesses.attribution: Compute separate baseline h==0 skip mask and candidate (h==0 OR certified) mask with entire seed page forced READ. Compare complete-unit counts from each mask, including lost h==0 opportunities in paid seed. Free true_amax oracle is a separate optimistic table.

controls: full GU plus exact post-A8 zero sparse Down, with identical available layout/hardware
gate exactly zero after actual GGML activation, no witness/bound, plus exact post-A8 zero Down
same scalar/page actions with metadata and stage costs exposed; stronger general sparse/approximate gate prior required before a positive paper claim
metrics: all operator/model/layer/token/expert coverage and finite checks
Every claimed primary zero checked against actual reference q8 and unchanged per-expert amax/scale bits after removal; q6/q4 shadows against respective own quantizers.
true-zero versus extra certificate-zero counts, excluding already exact gate zeros

Original-order complete logical4KiB/16KiB read-unit opportunities, two full masks with witness forced read, padding/cross-row policy explicit.16KiB is nominal AiF,4KiB hypothetical hardware extension; neither is native wave/latency.
Optimistic coefficient-work ratios with strong-baseline denominator; Down savings ideal per-coefficient d only unless physical layout proved. No native latency label.
norm/conditional/deflation metadata footprint and operation counts
Report physical dims and pooled row-byte denominators separately from prompt/class ratio means. Equalprojection coefficient-work comparisons never imply native delay bounds.
decision: Prespecified decisive bounded negative: on BOTH models, under free true-amax oracle and the per-row minimum of all primary conservative bounds, decode pooled additional gross Up weight-BYTES skip (sum skipped row bytes / sum selected Up bytes; additionally report prompt means, but no unweighted ratio averaging) beyond exact gate-zero <=1%, and ZERO additional complete16KiB unit opportunities versus gate-zero control. Secondary deflation is evaluated on last4 separately; decisive negative requires it also satisfy these limits. This retires this bound/reference performance regime only (ideal extra equal-projection dense-FFN coefficient saving <=0.334% even before costs), not all certificates/all models. Any larger, mixed, or only page-negative result is inconclusive and requires same-round follow-up protocol before new data. Positive scalar headroom is not speedup/submission success. User10% flag is not a hard fail threshold.
required_before_launch: at least 1800 seconds substantive candidate thinking
Sol/Gemini cross review and critic approval for bounded test
final protocol/source freeze before actual candidate data are read

floating_contract.gate: Call pinned ggml_vec_silu_f32 at full original I length with same ISA/actual gate; compare to actual fused graph product. A compressed subset or unrelated scalar exp is invalid. If graph differs, fallback and report.
floating_contract.certificate: B integer conservative bound; U=scale_output(B,sw,sx) with exact canonical operation order; Ba=F32(abs(actual_h)*U); sL=F32(L/Qmax); finite positive sL, Ba<L, F32(Ba/sL)<0.5 required. L0/nonfinite/underflow/unsupported FTZ fallback. Verify claimed zeros, amaxbits and scale bits. A6/A4 shadow tested against own q6/q4, never against q8.
floating_contract.environment: Record compiler version, ISA, optimization -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off, F32 rounding mode and FTZ/DAZ. Check integer overflow before128bit products; exact integer sqrt/directed checked intervals; conditional G=0 or invalid Gram falls back to global bound.

repair_policy: CLI/build/assertion/tooling bugs are repaired and retried within same experimental round. A numerical correctness bug invalidates that run, not scientific method failure; advance only on completed scientific negative after critic review.
page_model: Logical opportunity diagnostic: each expert Up matrix independently aligned to the stated unit, original contiguous row-major I8 weights, last unit padded and paid unless all real rows skippable. Count all intersecting rows if a row crosses a page. No claimed four-plane/native placement. This assumption is an optimistic opportunity bound, not an existing physical mapping.
